messages.ko: 바쁘게 지내다 이번엔 어떤 이쁜 말들을 적어놨을까
messages.en: I've been busy, so I came wondering what sweet messages you all wrote this time.
I came by to check them again today,
and after reading all the lovely messages cheering me on and showing me love,
I just couldn't help but reply.

messages.ko: 진짜 지치다가도 덕분에 막 힘이 난다앙
messages.en: Even when I'm exhausted, you always give me strength.
I came because I wanted to tell you how lovely you all are.
I'm all ready for bed now.
Even though I have to get up again soon??????
It's finally starting to feel real that our comeback isn't far away.
Did you listen to the highlight medley?
What did you think?
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ
I think...
it's the kind of song that gets better the more you listen to it.
Maybe it feels a little unfamiliar at first,
but if you keep listening, there's this overwhelming feeling that builds up.
Make sure you find my parts.
And don't do what happened last album where you went,
"Huh?"
"This is Hayeon's part! ><"
when it was actually someone else's. 😆
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋㅋ

messages.ko: 내가 노래마다 목소리가 좀 달라지긴 해서
messages.en: My voice changes a little depending on the song,
so you'll have to recognize me by my signature breathing.
But what if... what if we really can't find it?
Just wait and see.
Being able to sing with a different voice for each song...
that's one of my strengths.
Meanwhile I'll probably be watching,
thinking, 'My part's here... not there...'
That's probably what I'll be saying. 😆
Do your best~
If you get them all right, I'll be really touched~
I've been so busy lately,
so I feel like I can't stay here with you for very long.
I wanted to stay and chat for a long time whenever I came.
But you all said it's better if I message you consistently, right??
So I'll keep messaging whenever I have time.
Ah...
I'm already getting excited thinking about showing you something cool on stage,
I can't fall asleep.
I miss you.
I miss you so muchhh.
We'll see each other soon.
I'll be waiting.
ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅠㅠ You sound sleepy though?
Are you trying to make me fall asleep??
I'm worried since you have to wake up early.
Yeah. ㅎㅎ
Let's talk again.
Leave me lots of messages so I can read them anytime.
Leave lots for me.
I always read them.
ㅋㅋㅋㅋ I love you.
Sleep well.
Haranghae 😍😍
